body:
Read from github.com/EarthmanMuons/zmx-picker, 2026-11-05. 0BSD, v0.4.0, one bash script plus tests/run.sh with an expect harness and a stub zmx. Not found in nixpkgs under zmx-picker or zp.

- Needs zmx and fzf >= 0.51 (nixpkgs has 0.74.5); awk and sed in use; fd, git, jj optional.
- Creates sessions with a plain `zmx attach NAME`, so it inherits labels and scope through the overlay.
- Names are <repo>.<n>, with dots in the repo name folded to `_`. So first-dot splitting is right for zp, and dl-zmx.el should adopt the same fold.
- Clears ZMX_SESSION_PREFIX on its own calls, which the wrapper ignores harmlessly.

Packaged in pkgs/zp. Upstream's suite passes 29/29 in the Nix sandbox, with one test's hardcoded /bin/bash substituted.

End to end on the host: real zp, fzf and wrapper in a pty, scratch ZMX_DIR, one seeded session, typing demo.1 and Enter created project=demo id=1 in a scope distinct from the caller's.

The same run with no sessions and no ZP_ROOT created nothing. Inferred: zp opens no picker on an empty list, so ZP_ROOT matters for first use. The reason was not read from the source.

Cosmetic: --version and --help print `.zp-wrapped`, because wrapProgram renames the script and zp reads $0.
title: zp as it actually is
